name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (NSAP)
benefit: Monthly pension for BPL senior citizens aged 60 and above; state top-up varies
verification_note: Seed data written from public knowledge; confirm rules, amounts and URLs on the official source before relying on them.
notes: Amount and state top-up must be confirmed on the official portal.

documents.name: Aadhaar (identity only — do not enter the number in this app)

steps: Visit the gram panchayat, taluk office or the local service centre to get the NSAP application form
Submit the form with age proof and BPL card
Track the application status on the NSAP portal using the acknowledgement number
Note the acknowledgement number and check pension disbursal with the local office
